services.name: Meditation session
services.desc: Join us for an extraordinary sound bath after the garden closes to other visitors. This ancient therapeutic practice uses sound and deep listening to foster connection and healing. Incorporating various musical instruments and the sounds and resonance of the place itself, sound practitioner Ben Brown will create an immersive sound environment wherein participants lie down or sit and simply focus on listening to reach a relaxed state, heighten awareness, and elevate the consciousness. No prior experience with meditation or yoga is required. Participants should bring a yoga mat, blanket, or folding chair and water. services.desc: Celebrate NASA’s International Observe the Moon Night with family and friends under the nearly full moon. Tucked in an ancient glacial bowl that defines the horizon, Innisfree has very little light pollution, making night sky viewing here a sublime experience.
